name: MAGE
description: Arcane mastery. The mage bends the weave of the world with focused will.
blurb: In the subaqueous libraries of Saltmere, mages pore over forbidden texts etched in coral.

name: CLERIC
description: Faith and healing. The cleric mends what the battle breaks.
blurb: In the radiant cloisters of Sunspire, clerics tend to the wounded and the weary.

name: RUNESMITH
description: Hammer and rune. The runesmith carves power into permanence.
blurb: In the forge-deeps of Emberhold, runesmiths speak the language of molten stone.

name: TIDECALLER
description: Waves and whispers. The tidecaller commands the ocean's memory.
blurb: From the drowned spires of Saltmere, tidecallers sing the old songs that move the sea.

name: DAWNWARD
description: Light and boundary. The dawnward stands at the edge of the dark.
blurb: At the outer courts of Sunspire, dawnwards hold the line between day and what follows.

name: OCCULTIST
description: Secrets and sacrifice. The occultist bargains with what should not be named.
blurb: In the veiled catacombs of Duskchapel, occultists trade pieces of themselves for forbidden knowledge.

name: THIEF
description: Shadow and silver. The thief strikes where the light forgets to look.
blurb: From the candle-lit crypts of Duskchapel, thieves move through the silence between heartbeats, taking what the dead no longer need.

name: RANGER
description: Shot and silence. The ranger moves unseen between the old trees.
blurb: In the mist-choked lowlands of Greyhollow, rangers walk the paths that exist only between heartbeats.
